crossRefs.note: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their…
Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from…
You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel…
Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”
“For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far…
Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

translations.web: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
translations.bsb: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
translations.kjv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
translations.asv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
